detailed_description: The Image Collage tool combines selected images into a single PNG collage in the browser. You can upload multiple images, choose a horizontal or vertical layout, adjust spacing, set a solid background color, reorder or remove images from the list, generate the collage on a canvas, preview the result, and download the finished PNG. The tool keeps the original image dimensions when placing images and does not include freeform dragging, text overlays, rotation controls, or layout templates beyond horizontal and vertical stacking.
usage_steps: Select one or more image files with the upload area.
Choose horizontal or vertical layout, then adjust spacing and background color.
Reorder images with the arrow buttons or remove any image you do not want to include.
Click Create Collage to generate the preview, then download the result as a PNG.
usage_examples: Example 1: Combine several screenshots into one horizontal PNG for a quick bug report.
Example 2: Stack before-and-after images vertically with a small gap between them.
Example 3: Set a white or colored background behind images that have transparent areas.
Example 4: Reorder uploaded photos and generate a simple contact-sheet style image.
